note: Likelihood and impact use a 1 to 5 scale. Residual values assume the listed controls operate as designed. Scores are a starting position for a deploying institution to recalibrate.

fraud_vectors.how_it_works: One person fronts many disposable companies so the real controllers stay off the record.
fraud_vectors.graph_signal: Resolved person node with a high count of director edges into shell like companies, mostly as sole director.
fraud_vectors.detection: Person entity resolution, then a score built from appointment volume, share of shell like companies and share of sole directorships.
fraud_vectors.preventive: Onboarding rule: enhanced due diligence for any company whose director exceeds the appointment threshold.
fraud_vectors.detective: Weekly rescoring of all resolved directors and alerts on new nominees.
fraud_vectors.corrective: Review every company fronted by the confirmed nominee as one connected case and exit or restrict where control cannot be evidenced.
fraud_vectors.kpi: Recall on planted nominees, share of nominee appointments recovered by resolution

fraud_vectors.how_it_works: A single office hosts hundreds of paper companies that are used briefly and abandoned.
fraud_vectors.graph_signal: Address node with a very large company count where most companies are short lived and directors are overseas.
fraud_vectors.detection: Address resolution across formatting variants, then a behaviour score from early dissolution, missing accounts and overseas directors.
fraud_vectors.preventive: Address risk rating applied at onboarding to every company registered at a flagged address.
fraud_vectors.detective: Monthly rebuild of address statistics with alerts when an address crosses the score threshold.
fraud_vectors.corrective: Bulk review of existing customers at the address and report of suspected false addresses to the registrar.
fraud_vectors.anchor: Economic Crime and Corporate Transparency Act 2023 registered office rules
fraud_vectors.kpi: Precision against legitimate agents, companies covered per flagged address

fraud_vectors.how_it_works: Companies are recorded as controlling each other in a loop so that no natural person is ever named.
fraud_vectors.graph_signal: Strongly connected component of size above one in the ownership graph, including edges through offshore entities.
fraud_vectors.detection: Corporate controller resolution followed by strongly connected component analysis and extraction of the shortest loop as evidence.
fraud_vectors.preventive: Onboarding block until a natural person is evidenced as ultimate owner.
fraud_vectors.detective: Loop detection on every graph rebuild.
fraud_vectors.corrective: Discrepancy report to the registrar and escalation to the nominated officer.
fraud_vectors.anchor: Companies Act 2006 Part 21A and MLR 2017 regulation 30A
fraud_vectors.kpi: Loops recovered, loops lost to unresolved corporate links

fraud_vectors.how_it_works: A designated person controls a company through one or more intermediate entities and under a variant spelling.
fraud_vectors.graph_signal: Directed control path of bounded length from a screened list match to the company.
fraud_vectors.detection: Transliteration aware screening with date of birth logic, then downstream reach along control edges with risk that decays by hop.
fraud_vectors.preventive: Screening of all officers, controllers and upstream entities before onboarding and payment release.
fraud_vectors.detective: Rescreen on every list update and every graph rebuild.
fraud_vectors.corrective: Freeze where ownership or control is established, report to OFSI, manual review for name only matches.
fraud_vectors.anchor: Sanctions and Anti Money Laundering Act 2018 and OFSI ownership and control test
fraud_vectors.kpi: Recall by hop distance, false alerts from namesakes, review turnaround

fraud_vectors.how_it_works: The declared controller is a company in a secrecy jurisdiction, so the public chain ends without a person.
fraud_vectors.graph_signal: No natural person reachable upstream through control edges and a high opacity jurisdiction on the chain.
fraud_vectors.detection: Upstream ownership profile with jurisdiction opacity weights, chain depth and filing health, plus leak data as a second lens.
fraud_vectors.preventive: Requirement for certified ownership documents before onboarding any company with an offshore corporate controller.
fraud_vectors.detective: Alerts when a customer adds or changes to an offshore corporate controller.
fraud_vectors.corrective: Enhanced due diligence, discrepancy report and exit where the owner cannot be identified.
fraud_vectors.anchor: Companies Act 2006 Part 21A and MLR 2017 regulation 28
fraud_vectors.kpi: Share of opaque chains with an identified natural person after review

fraud_vectors.how_it_works: Companies are created in batches and abandoned, or dissolved and reborn under a near identical name.
fraud_vectors.graph_signal: Runs of same director, same address incorporations within days, and dissolved to new company pairs with similar names.
fraud_vectors.detection: Run detection over director and address pairs and name similarity between a dissolved company and its successor.
fraud_vectors.preventive: Onboarding check of dissolved companies linked to each director.
fraud_vectors.detective: Alerts when a customer director forms a new lookalike company.
fraud_vectors.corrective: Link the batch or chain into one case and consider a report to the Insolvency Service.
fraud_vectors.anchor: Insolvency Act 1986 section 216 and Company Directors Disqualification Act 1986
fraud_vectors.kpi: Batches and chains recovered, false alerts on property vehicle batches

system_risks.impact: A false accusation against a company or person.
system_risks.mitigation: Every narrative claim must cite evidence identifiers. A verifier rejects claims whose entities or numbers do not appear in the cited evidence.

system_risks.impact: A hostile company name steers the model to clear the company.
system_risks.mitigation: Registry strings are sanitised and quoted as data, instruction like wording is flagged as a red flag, and the model has no ability to change a score.
Scores come from deterministic detectors. The language model only explains them. A claim that states a different risk band is rejected.

system_risks.impact: An innocent person inherits the appointments of someone else.
system_risks.mitigation: Blocking on month and year of birth, conservative name thresholds, every spelling variant shown in the dossier for human confirmation.

system_risks.risk: Namesake matched to a sanctions entry
system_risks.impact: An innocent customer is treated as designated.
system_risks.mitigation: Date of birth logic, name only matches capped at review level, dossier wording limited to potential match.

system_risks.impact: Reliance on dated and unverified records.
system_risks.mitigation: Leak edges are labelled by source in every evidence item and the typology library instructs reviewers to verify before acting.

system_risks.impact: Reviewers are guided by superseded rules.
system_risks.mitigation: The typology library is a versioned file with named sources. Retrieval quality is measured on every run.
Only data that is already public is processed, the service returns dossiers on request rather than in bulk, and no prompt is sent to an external model unless a provider is configured.
Hard negatives planted for every typology, results reported per typology with error analysis, loaders provided for the public sources so thresholds can be recalibrated.
